Class ShapeRectDrawing

Namespace
ShapeEngine.StaticLib.Drawing
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides static extension methods for drawing rectangles and grids, including advanced features such as nine-patch, rounded corners, slanted corners, partial outlines, and more.

Remarks

All methods are designed for use with Raylib and ShapeEngine types. Methods are implemented as extensions for convenient usage.

DrawCorners(Rect, LineDrawingInfo, float)

Draws corner lines for a rectangle, with all corners having the same length.

public static void DrawCorners(this Rect rect, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, float cornerLength)

Parameters

rect Rect

The rectangle to draw.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

The line drawing information (thickness, color, etc.).

cornerLength float

The length of the corner lines for all corners. Uses an absolute value from 0 to Min(width,height) of the rect. Therefore, the corner value should be positive and not exceed the smallest dimension of the rect.

pivot Vector2

The scale factor for each side.

  • 0: No Rect is drawn.

The point along each side to scale from, in both directions (0 to 1).

Useful for creating stylized or animated rectangles.

DrawRectLinesPercentage(Vector2, Vector2, float, float, ColorRgba, LineCapType, int)

Draws a certain percentage of a rectangle's outline, starting at a specified corner and direction.

public static void DrawRectLinesPercentage(Vector2 topLeft, Vector2 bottomRight, float f, float lineThickness, ColorRgba color, LineCapType capType = LineCapType.CappedExtended, int capPoints = 2)

Parameters

topLeft Vector2

The top-left corner of the rectangle.

bottomRight Vector2

The bottom-right corner of the rectangle.

f float

Specifies which portion of the rectangle's outline to draw, as well as the starting corner and direction.

  • The integer part (0-3) selects the starting corner:
    • Counter-Clockwise -> 0 = top-left, 1 = bottom-left, 2 = bottom-right, 3 = top-right.
    • Clockwise -> 0 = top-left, 1 = top-right, 2 = bottom-right, 3 = bottom-left.
  • The fractional part (0.0-1.0) determines the percentage of the outline to draw, relative to the full perimeter.
  • A negative value reverses the drawing direction (clockwise instead of counter-clockwise).
Examples:
  • 0.35 - Start at top-left, draw 35% of the outline counter-clockwise.
  • -2.7 - Start at bottom-right, draw 70% of the outline clockwise.
lineThickness float

The thickness of the outline.

color ColorRgba

The color of the outline.

capType LineCapType

The type of line cap to use.

capPoints int

The number of points for the cap.

Remarks

Useful for progress indicators or animated outlines.
